findings.title: Stripe secret key (Anvil demo key) is shipped to every browser

evidence.response: 200 OK, body contains sk_anvildemo_[REDACTED 25 chars] (also present in build/assets/js/billing.js)

findings.why: A secret key (sk_live_) lets anyone who opens DevTools create charges, issue refunds and read customer data on your Stripe account. Only publishable keys (pk_live_) belong in front-end code.
findings.fix: Roll the key in the Stripe dashboard now (treat it as leaked). Move any call that needs the secret key to a server route that reads it from an environment variable, and keep only the publishable key in the browser.

findings.title: A member can read admin-only workspace settings
findings.why: Settings are admin-only in the UI, but the API only refuses guests. Any member can read them with one request, so hiding the page is not protection.
findings.fix: In the /api/settings handler, refuse every role except admin: if (s.role !== 'admin') return 403. Add a test that a member gets 403.

findings.title: Notes page scrolls sideways on a phone (853px wide at 390px)
findings.why: The notes table is forced to min-width 820px with no wrapping and no scroll container, so the whole page slides left and right on phones. Most of your users will see this first.
findings.fix: Wrap the table in a div with overflow-x: auto, or switch to a card layout below 640px.

findings.title: Shared-note hero image has no alt text
findings.why: Screen readers announce the file name instead of skipping the image (axe rule image-alt).
findings.fix: The image is decorative: add alt="".

findings.title: console.error on every load of admin settings
findings.why: An optional empty field is logged as an error. It is harmless today but hides real errors in your logs and error tracker.
findings.fix: Show a hint next to the field instead of logging, or log nothing (the field is optional).

Try to read a full row and open a note

notChecked.why: Anvil does not make real or test charges; the Stripe key finding comes from a static scan only.
No Supabase or Firebase config was found in the scanned code, so the read-only rules probe was skipped.

notChecked.what: Load, performance under traffic and rate limits
notChecked.why: Out of scope: Anvil runs one browser, not a load test.

notChecked.what: Server-side code paths not reachable from the pages crawled
notChecked.why: Only routes linked from crawled pages and the role-access plan were exercised.
Passing these checks does not make an app secure. Anvil reports what it checked and found, nothing more.
